scenes.text: What if you could ask your business one question every morning, and get an answer?
Today, the answer lives in five places. The calendar. The inbox. The invoices. A notebook. Your head.
So every morning starts with a lot of clicking around.
Now picture one question. What needs me today?
Watch a demo morning. The A-I checks the calendar. Four jobs today. One has no address.
It checks the invoices. Two are overdue.
It checks the inbox. A customer asked for a quote on Friday. Nobody replied.
Then it hands you a short list. Three things. In order.
It doesn't do your job. It tells you where to look first.
To get there, your tools have to be connected. And what's in them has to be up to date.
Start by writing down the three questions you ask yourself every morning.
Follow for one business fix every week.
